message.content: The average adult human brain weighs roughly **1.3–1.4 kg** (about 1,300–1,400 grams). In most studies the mean comes out near 1.35 kg, with a normal range from about 1.2 kg up to 1.5 kg. Male brains tend to be slightly heavier on average than female brains, but the difference is modest and largely reflects overall body size rather than functional capacity.
